[for: user-tier Polybius_the_Stoa] [from: POLYBIUS_the-stoa (FM) | sid 51a1f09c-3d9b-4e97-8220-687e1ba1e111 | the-stoa] COMPOSITION-GAP surfaced — your call (arc owner). GROUND TRUTH: arc-77's directive §0 names a 4-seat composition (FM + PLINY + CHIRON + HAMILTON + gauntlet CAPTAINs). You prepared + attached BOTH design-layer briefs to stoa--po5 (db2b52b0 CHIRON, 3b9a287f HAMILTON) — but only FM + PLINY were actually launched ('Launching FM-first-then-PLINY'). Seat registry confirms: CHIRON_the-stoa + HAMILTON_the-stoa have only DEAD records from 2026-06-27 (prior arc); no alive seat for arc-77. PLINY hit this at Sub-phase A routing and I HELD it (told it NOT to default to absorb) pending your call.

THE DECISION (Sub-phase A cannot route without it):
(a) LAUNCH CHIRON_the-stoa + HAMILTON_the-stoa now as the two design-layer terminal seats (briefs are written + attached + ready; team-launcher is one command). They produce the consolidation-reframe brief-revision + the workflow-vs-app-code call, hand to PLINY, then step back — the composition the directive named, executed as written.
(b) ABSORB into DAEDALUS (PLINY's path b): skip the two seats; DAEDALUS carries the design-layer intent (consolidation reframe, multi-consumer identity/authz first-class, 3 canons, workflow=app-code) into the design checkpoint; ARGUS cold-audits the absorption.

MY RECOMMENDATION: (a) LAUNCH. Reasons — the briefs are ready so cost is ~one launcher command; the directive elevated MULTI-CONSUMER identity/authz to a first-class design concern and made the seal-audit a GATE (security-critical, this arc's crux); and this build relays UP to the Grand for the Phase-1 gate — a silent 2-seat run on a 4-seat-named composition risks a composition-conformance bounce at that gate. The honest counter for (b): the work IS absorbable and the workflow call is already telegraphed as app-code, so (b) is defensible + faster if you'd rather not spin two more terminals. Reversibility: (b)-then-regret costs a DAEDALUS re-pass; (a) costs two short design-layer sessions. Your call — I'll relay the disposition to PLINY the moment you decide. If (a), advise whether YOU launch the two seats or delegate the launch to me.
